name: digital-presence
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a premium editorial photograph for the homepage hero of Quadem Digital, a founder-led digital studio in Ghana selling web design, branding and content. This must feel like a carefully art-directed commercial photograph, NOT a 3D illustration, NOT generic floating objects.
Landscape 1536x1024 composition. A beautifully restrained real creative workspace: a slim graphite laptop showing an elegant abstract website layout with a large blue photograph and small typographic bars, a single phone displaying the corresponding responsive layout, a small stack of tactile warm-white brand stationery, one vivid cyan-blue folded sheet. The composition communicates one coherent business presence across web, mobile and identity. No people.
Objects grouped in the right 55 percent, on a deep midnight-blue matte desk with a matching dark backdrop. The left 45 percent is mostly unoccupied dark navy with subtle natural texture, so white HTML copy can be placed there. Laptop and phone clearly visible, accurate perspective, softly directional daylight from upper right, understated soft shadows, authentic paper grain and brushed metal. Editorial medium-format still life, sharp clean focus, tasteful premium craftsmanship. Quadem cyan #00aeef used sparingly in the interface and paper; midnight #03111d, warm white #f2efe8.
No legible written words, no logos, no watermarks, no invented performance numbers, no charts, no decorative spheres, no neon, no clutter, no stock-photo office, no hands. Screens are illustrative abstract layouts, not claimed client projects. Frame with room around edges and keep the subject in the central right area for responsive crop. This will be used as an actual website image asset.
